decisions.decision: Staff directed that the board take the ideas listed at the charrette, look for common themes, and refocus them for another future discussion, with a timeline to be set.

budget_items.topic: Cost of changes to town buildings
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Participants said the cost of any change to the buildings must be understood before deciding anything.
budget_items.quote: we need to understand how much this is going to cost to make any changes to anything.

budget_items.topic: Demolition cost of old Primary School
budget_items.what_was_recorded: A group asked what the demolition cost would be for the old Primary School and suggested a controlled Fire Dept. burn to save money.
budget_items.quote: what is the demolition cost? have the fire dept. do a controlled burn to demo it; save money.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: A group proposed an Arts and Cultural Center in Town Hall, noting grants are available and asking the cost.
budget_items.quote: town hall: an arts and cultural center; there are grants available, what is the cost?

budget_items.what_was_recorded: It was noted that cost assessments of ten different options cannot be requested because it is too expensive, so the options were to be narrowed.
budget_items.quote: it was noted we can't request cost assessments of ten different options as it is too expensive.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Suggested setting up an Amazon Smile account for a charitable organization so that a share of every sale goes to the non-profit, to help pay for the work.
budget_items.quote: in order to pay for this, smile. amazon.com allows you to set up an account for a charitable organization where .05% from every sale goes to the non-profit
